decisions.statement: Work is added by writing a prompt file into the queue while the worker runs.
A prompt file taken out of the queue before that file is picked up is not rendered.
A queue with nothing leaves the worker idling rather than ending that worker.
The worker ends when the stop file appears.
One render runs at a time.
One inference runs at a time.
A prompt file may pin the seed with a leading line naming that seed.
A prompt file is claimed before that file is rendered.
No retraction double-runs a claimed file.
A render that fails is logged and not retried.
A lock file refuses a second worker over the same folder.

definition: a queue of prompt files rendered as each one arrives
